vocabulary.RITUAL: the sacrifice and its performance: rites, officiants, oblations, implements and the acts that make up a rite
vocabulary.COSMOLOGICAL: the ordered world and its powers: the three worlds, the waters, dawn, the seasons, the phenomena a hymn addresses as agents
vocabulary.MATERIAL: worked and unworked physical stuff: metals, substances, made objects, weapons, grain as a commodity
vocabulary.BIOTIC: living kinds as living kinds: plants and animals
vocabulary.SOCIAL: human collectivities and the relations inside them: tribes, kingship, kinship, alliance, rivalry, the ancestors
vocabulary.CORPOREAL: the body and what happens to it: parts, breath, lifespan, affliction, healing, death
vocabulary.SPECULATIVE: the abstract vocabulary the hymns reason with: order, truth, being, mind, formulation, and the qualities predicated of gods and men
vocabulary.GEOGRAPHIC: located things: rivers as places, mountains, fields, dwellings
